name: gather_more_wood
description: Cut three more trees to reach a minimum of 30 Wood in inventory.
task: Hold at least 30 Wood (any kind: Wood, BorealWood, PalmWood...).

name: craft_workbench_from_trees
description: Cut three trees to get enough Wood, then craft a WorkBench.
task: Hold a work bench (any wood variant counts, e.g. BorealWoodWorkBench).

name: obtain_wooden_hammer
description: Collect wood, create a workbench, and craft a wooden hammer.
task: Hold a wooden hammer (any wood variant counts).

name: mine_stone_blocks
description: Collect at least 30 StoneBlock by mining nearby stone with the existing pickaxe.

name: make_chair_and_table_again
description: Gather additional wood, build a workbench if needed, craft a wooden hammer, then craft one wooden chair and one wooden table.
task: Hold a wooden chair and a wooden table (any wood variant counts).

name: obtain_wooden_door
description: Collect wood, build a workbench, then craft one WoodenDoor.
task: Hold a wooden door (any wood variant counts).

name: hold_furnace_again
description: Gather missing stone blocks and craft a Furnace.

name: cut_one_more_tree_for_wood
description: Mine the nearest tree to reach a minimum of 30 Wood in inventory.
task: Hold at least 30 Wood (any kind: Wood, BorealWood, PalmWood...).
